title: Novel, Innovative Research pour Understanding Dehydration dans adultes et Kids (NIRUDAK) score
diseases: Troubles gastro-intestinaux fonctionnels de l’enfant et de l’adolescent
abbreviations: Novel, Innovative Research for Understanding Dehydration in Adults and Kids (NIRUDAK) Score
formula:
The NIRUDAK Score is calculated by the addition of the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Skin pinch | Rapid | 0 |
| Slow | 2 | |
| Very slow | 4 | |
| Eye level | Normal | 0 |
| Sunken | 2 | |
| Respiration depth | Normal | 0 |
| Deep | 2 | |
| Urine output | Normal | 0 |
| Decreased or dark | 1 | |
| Minimal or none | 2 | |
| Radial pulse | Strong | 0 |
| Decreased | 1 | |
| Absent | 4 | |

how_to_use.why:
- More accurate in assessing dehydration severity than the WHO Integrated Management of Adolescent and Adult Illness (IMAI) algorithm and standard clinical judgment alone.
- Enhances consistency among healthcare providers, reducing variability in dehydration assessment.
- Helps optimize fluid management decisions, minimizing unnecessary IV fluids while ensuring appropriate treatment for severe cases.
how_to_use.when: Use for patients aged 5 years and older presenting with acute diarrhea in resource-limited settings to assess dehydration severity.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Originally derived from data on 2,172 patients aged 5 and older with acute diarrhea (≥3 loose stools per day for ≤7 days) in Bangladesh.
- Patients were classified by percent weight change with rehydration into the following categories: severe dehydration (>9% weight change), some dehydration (3%–9% weight change), or no dehydration (<3% weight change).
- Not validated for diarrhea caused by conditions other than gastroenteritis or for dehydration from non-diarrheal causes.
- Several versions of this tool exist. This simplified, points-based version was introduced in a[2023 study by Levine et al](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37776870/). It incorporates urine output and radial pulse but does not include age, sex, vomiting episodes, or systolic blood pressure from the full model.

next_steps.advice: This tool should not replace clinical judgment—signs of shock or altered mental status warrant urgent intervention regardless of the score.
next_steps.management:
**No dehydration (score 0–3):**

- Encourage fluid intake and continue a normal diet.
- Provide education on warning signs for deterioration.

**Some dehydration (score 4–6):**

- Initiate oral rehydration solution (ORS).
- Consider short-term observation in a healthcare setting.

**Severe dehydration (score ≥7):**

- Initiate IV rehydration immediately.
- Hospitalize if resources allow.
- Monitor for complications (e.g., electrolyte abnormalities, worsening dehydration).

more_info:
Interpretation:

| NIRUDAK Score | Dehydration Category |
| --- | --- |
| 0-3 | No dehydration |
| 4-6 | Some dehydration |
| ≥7 | Severe dehydration |
